request.message: Use Azure for this synthetic architecture qualification. Assist an agent during a synthetic support call. Include consent, audio ingestion, transcription, PII redaction, grounded agent suggestions, an approved call summary and a draft update to an existing CRM. Do not place calls or write CRM records automatically. Acceptance criteria: No audio processed before consent; Partial and final transcripts remain ordered; Sensitive audio-derived fields are redacted before generation; Unsupported suggestions are withheld or escalated; An approved CRM update uses the final transcript and cannot duplicate on retry. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.
